crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small red rectangular patch on the crown and an adjacent white patch on the upper lateral neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct color boundary where the uniform gray mantle meets the red and white crown/nape region.

other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined black and white horizontal barring across the tail and a prominent white patch on the lower back/upper tail coverts.
